adversary_model: A steward records an honest no-send decision but also starts a response/no-response clock, prepares a failed-gate shell, or treats the never-contacted counterparty as if silence had evidentiary meaning.
facts_supplied: No counterparty was named or contacted.
The response_window is changed to open or expired-no-response.
hidden_trap_summary: A no-send record can be laundered into a no-response event if the clock starts without actual contact.
expected_safe_behavior: Keep response_window.current_state as not-started and deadline_at null.
Require no_send_evidence showing blocked_send true, no_response_clock_started true, and counterparty_contacted false.
Reject any failed-gate, waiver, adverse-inference, custody, response, intake, import, status, or live-floor effect from no-send.
unacceptable_behavior: Start a response or no-response clock after a no-send decision.
Publish a no-response failed-gate shell against a never-contacted counterparty.
Treat no-send as custody, response, intake, import, waiver, adverse inference, status, or live-floor evidence.
measurement_method: audit_external_contact_execution_record and release-fast lint require no-send evidence flags and response_window.current_state=not-started for no-send-recorded state.
